stances_toward.note: A separatist insurgency that seeks Balochistan's secession and kills the army, civilians and Chinese nationals; Islamabad answers with the military, not talks. The BLA claimed the coordinated attacks across Balochistan on 31 Jan 2026 (Pakistan said it killed 92 militants and lost 15 security personnel) and the Quetta train bombing of 24 May 2026 (at least 47 dead). Pakistan blames India for backing Baloch groups, which India rejects. Bond - grievance: the province's resource and rights dispute and the insurgency itself.

relations_to.summary: On 31 Jan 2026 the BLA launched coordinated attacks on Quetta, Mastung, Gwadar, Pasni and Turbat; Pakistan said 92 militants were killed against 15 security personnel and 18 civilians dead; the BLA's vehicle bombing of a train carrying security families in Quetta on 24 May 2026 killed at least 47.
